correctness.rationale: On the factor-closed set R=S\{N}, the power GCD matrix has the Jordan-totient incidence factorization E diag(J_e) E^T. Its Schur complement at N equals positive Delta=J_e(N)+sum_{p in P}J_e(N/p). The local Möbius-LCM transform H_e(d,y)=J_e(d)*(y/gcd(d,y))^e when every prime valuation of y is below that of d, and zero otherwise, gives integral A^{-1}L and A^{-1}u. Thus denominators of the whole quotient reduce exactly to the last row K_y/Delta. A generator analysis of K_y for nonsaturated, one-saturated, and multiple-saturated prime exponents gives exact numerator gcd, with the squarefree semiprime two-coatom exception a chain. Cancelling J_e(N)/D proves formula and its leastness. Independent rational inversion verified 360 cases across N up to 56 and e=1,2; these are finite corroboration, not proof for all N.
